scope: Cloud WORK source adaptation only; no local integration/publication/browser execution
baselineDefiniteGaps: Existing ready was a Boolean asset counter, not an awaitable initialization contract; errors before lifecycle installation could leave the early no-op disposer.
GSAP owns a ticker independently of the source callback, so source stop/remove alone did not explicitly sleep that ticker.
sourceFixes: Ready Promise now resolves after all six actual portraits load and the authored scene is rendered; shader diagnostics and initialization errors reject.
Early owned resource cleanup handles partial boot; named ticker/tweens, pointer capture, images, observers, geometry/materials/textures/context are disposed. Stop sleeps the owned GSAP ticker.
Both GLSL strings, 26-ribbon geometry, CONFIG, strip layout and resize math remain byte-identical.
loaderAudit: new Image + src setter -> scoped broker -> owned Blob URL -> Three Texture. Six local JPEG bytes remain exact source.
Local classic Three128/GSAP3.12.5; no font, worker, decoder, module CORS or remote path.
renderer: Three128 WebGL1/2 renderer; GLSL1 ribbon vertex/fragment shaders; no float framebuffer dependency.
nativeInputAndReducedMotion: Native horizontal real-pointer capture, drag/fling preserved. Reduced motion freezes ambient phase and uses direct drag redraw without fling.
runtimePending: Final trusted native-pointer / nonce lifecycle bridge must be injected and manifest-listed by Motion Vault packaging.
Opaque allow-scripts-only origin: actual CSP, broker, texture/font/model decode and first frame require browser verification.
GPU shader/material/FBO correctness, original1100x670 composition, native drag/scroll/touch and cross-boundary release remain untested.
Normal/reduced startup and live preference changes; stop-before-ready/resume/dispose/reopen and resource/memory behavior remain untested.
Local application/publication remains gated on compatibility; source build/parse/mock checks do not establish runtime acceptance.
initializationContract: ready Promise; isReady Boolean; actual required resource and initial render predicates, rejecting failures. Fulfillment is not visual acceptance.
disposalContract: Terminal/idempotent dispose; may return Promise. Host frame destruction remains the final isolation boundary.
mediaRights: Existing independent media/font/license caveats retained; compatibility checks do not clear third-party asset rights.
